dialogue.content: 本日はどうぞよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.content: もしも準備がよろしかったら、始めさせていただいてよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: If you're ready, shall we begin?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm ready. Please go ahead.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm your counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 委員会を辞めるかどうかなやんでます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling with whether or not to quit the committee.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、大切なお話ですねよかったらもう少し詳しくお話しいただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds important. If you feel comfortable, could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: 学級委員になったんですけど、最近学校にあまり行けてないから参加できてなくて
dialogue.English: I became a class representative, but I haven't been able to go to school much lately, so I haven't been able to participate.

dialogue.content: 自分からなろう！ってなったのに
dialogue.English: Even though I volunteered for it myself.

dialogue.content: それでこの前学校遅刻して行ったとき、
dialogue.English: And the other day, when I went to school late,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 委員会が午後あるの知らなくて
dialogue.English: I didn't know there was a committee meeting in the afternoon.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: もう一人の委員の子からキレ気味に「早くきて！」って言われて
dialogue.English: The other committee member snapped at me, saying, "Hurry up and get here!"

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったのですね。。
dialogue.English: So that's what happened...

dialogue.content: ついていったんですけど見失って
dialogue.English: I tried to follow them, but I lost them.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: トイレに籠って結局出られませんでした
dialogue.English: I ended up hiding in the bathroom and couldn't come out.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それはとても辛いですよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: あとで謝ったんですけど
dialogue.English: I apologized later, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なんかもう行きづらくて
dialogue.English: it's just become hard for me to go.

dialogue.content: その子に悪口言われるし
dialogue.English: And that person says bad things about me.

dialogue.content: それは行くの嫌になってしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: That would make you not want to go, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: どんなことを言われたのでしょうか
dialogue.English: What kinds of things did they say?

dialogue.content: 全然来ないのになんでなったんだろうねって
dialogue.English: Something like, "I wonder why she even joined if she never comes."

dialogue.content: 確かにそうなんですけど
dialogue.English: It's true, but...

dialogue.content: そんなこと言われたら、ますます行きづらくなりますよね、、
dialogue.English: Hearing something like that would make it even harder to go, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: 行きたい思いはあるのに、、、
dialogue.English: Especially when you do want to go...

dialogue.content: だから次の委員会も行きたくないなぁって
dialogue.English: So now I don't feel like going to the next committee meeting either.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうなるのも無理ないですよね、、
dialogue.English: I understand. It's only natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 最初委員になった時はどんな感じでなったのでしょうか
dialogue.English: How did you end up joining the committee in the first place?

dialogue.content: 自分から立候補してなったんです
dialogue.English: I volunteered for it.

dialogue.content: 楽しそうだと思ったから
dialogue.English: I thought it seemed fun.

dialogue.content: うんうん、やってみたいと思ったのですね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, you felt you wanted to give it a try.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: それがだんだんと行きづらくなって、、何かきっかけとかはありましたか？
dialogue.English: But it gradually became hard to go... Was there any particular trigger?

dialogue.content: 学校を休みがちになったからです
dialogue.English: It's because I started to miss school a lot.

dialogue.content: 行けると思ってたんですけど
dialogue.English: I thought I would be able to go, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん、行きたいけど行けない、、しんどいですよね、、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, wanting to go but not being able to... that must be tough.

dialogue.content: 疲れやすくて体調もあまり良くなくて
dialogue.English: I get tired easily and I haven't been feeling well physically.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、体調がよくないと気持ちも落ち込んでしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. When you don't feel well physically, it can bring your spirits down too, can't it?

dialogue.content: そうなった何かきっかけとかはあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Was there anything that might have caused that to start?

dialogue.content: 元々中学校のときから不登校ではあったんです
dialogue.English: Well, I had issues with school avoidance back in middle school.

dialogue.content: 高校に行って大丈夫だと思ってたんですけど
dialogue.English: I thought I would be fine once I started high school, but...

dialogue.content: 疲れるみたいです
dialogue.English: It seems to be tiring for me.

dialogue.content: うんうん、せっかく高校からは行けると思ったのに、行けなくなるのはとても悔しいですよね、、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. It must be so frustrating to not be able to go, especially after thinking you'd finally be able to from high school.

dialogue.content: 疲れるというのはどんな感じになるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: When you say you get tired, what is that like for you?

dialogue.content: 身体がだるくて朝起きられないです。頭痛やめまいがするときもあります
dialogue.English: My body feels heavy and I can't get up in the morning. I sometimes have headaches and feel dizzy, too.

dialogue.content: そんな状態で学校に行こうと頑張っておられるのですね、、
dialogue.English: And you're still trying your best to go to school while feeling that way...

dialogue.content: なので遅刻して行くことがよくあります
dialogue.English: So I often end up going in late.

dialogue.content: 委員会に入らない方が良かったんでしょうか、、
dialogue.English: Maybe I shouldn’t have joined the committee...

dialogue.content: 学校に行くだけでも大変だと思いますよ
dialogue.English: Just going to school must be tough enough.

dialogue.content: 委員会には、何か特別な思いがおありなんでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do you have any special feelings or motivations regarding the committee?

dialogue.content: 特別なっていうと…楽しそうとかそういうことですか？
dialogue.English: By special, do you mean... like thinking it would be fun, or something like that?

dialogue.content: 何か高校に入って頑張るんだ！といったことでやってみたいとお思いになったのかな？と少し感じたものですから
dialogue.English: I just sensed that maybe you saw it as a way to challenge yourself and do your best after starting high school.

dialogue.content: それはあります
dialogue.English: Yes, there is that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、高校からは頑張りたかったんですよね
dialogue.English: Right, you wanted to do your best starting in high school.

dialogue.content: 身体がだるくて起きられないのは、いつ頃から続いていますか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been feeling this fatigue that makes it hard to get up?

dialogue.content: 中学からです
dialogue.English: Since middle school.

dialogue.content: 中学の時はどんな感じで過ごしておられましたか？
dialogue.English: What were things like for you in middle school?

dialogue.content: 今よりあんまり学校には行けてなかったです
dialogue.English: I was able to go to school even less than I do now.

dialogue.content: 行きたいのに行けないのは悔しいですよね、、
dialogue.English: It's frustrating when you want to go but you can't, isn't it?

dialogue.content: でも行けてない自分が悪いんです
dialogue.English: But it's my fault that I can't go.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに感じておられるのですね、、
dialogue.English: So that's how you're feeling about it...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 体調が悪くなりだしたのは、中学のいつぐらいからですか？
dialogue.English: When in middle school did you start feeling unwell?

dialogue.content: 中2くらいです
dialogue.English: Around my second year of middle school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: その頃に何か気になっていたこととかはありましたか
dialogue.English: Was there anything that was bothering you around that time?

dialogue.content: 気になっていたことはありません
dialogue.English: There wasn't anything I was worried about.

dialogue.content: いじめられてました
dialogue.English: I was being bullied.

dialogue.content: えっ、、、そんなことが、、、
dialogue.English: Oh... that was happening...

dialogue.content: 本当に大変な思いをされてきたのですね、、
dialogue.English: You've really been through a terrible time.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I have.

dialogue.content: もしよかったらその時のお話を聴かせていただけますか？（話せる範囲でかまいません）
dialogue.English: If you’re comfortable, could you tell me about that time? (Only as much as you feel able to share.)

dialogue.content: 悪口を言われて仲間はずれにされました
dialogue.English: People said bad things about me and I was ostracized.

dialogue.content: それは、ひどい、、
dialogue.English: That's awful...

dialogue.content: その人たちはどういった関係の人たちですか
dialogue.English: What was your relationship with those people?

dialogue.content: クラスの友だちでした
dialogue.English: They were classmates.

dialogue.content: それは学校に行けなくなりますよね、、
dialogue.English: That would definitely make it hard to go to school...

dialogue.content: もうその人たちはいなくなったので今は平気です
dialogue.English: Those people are gone now, so I'm okay.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: もう少しお聴きしても大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Is it alright if I ask a little more about this?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いじめられていた時は、誰かに相談とかはされていましたか？
dialogue.English: When you were being bullied, did you talk to anyone about it?

dialogue.content: しました
dialogue.English: I did.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それはとても勇気がいったと思います
dialogue.English: I see. That must have taken a lot of courage.

dialogue.content: どなたに相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: Who did you talk to?

dialogue.content: 親と先生に
dialogue.English: My parents and a teacher.

dialogue.content: その後、いじめの方はどうなりましたか？
dialogue.English: What happened with the bullying after that?

dialogue.content: クラスが離れたのでやり過ごせました
dialogue.English: We were separated into different classes, so I was able to get through it.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、なんとか時間が解決してくれたという感じでしょうか、、
dialogue.English: I see. So it sounds like time eventually resolved the situation, in a way?

dialogue.content: そんな感じです
dialogue.English: Something like that.

dialogue.content: ご自身は今その時のことを振り返ってみてどんなことを感じますか？
dialogue.English: Looking back on that time now, how do you feel about it?

dialogue.content: あまり思い出したくないですね
dialogue.English: I don't really want to remember it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、何であんな目にあわないといけないだって思うと思い出すのも嫌になりますよね、、
dialogue.English: Of course... when you think 'Why did I have to go through that?', it's natural to not want to remember it.

dialogue.content: もう終わったので
dialogue.English: It's over now.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうですよね、、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, right...

dialogue.content: 少しお話まとめさせていただいてよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarized our conversation a bit?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 高校の委員会に入ったけれども、学校に行けなかったり、遅刻することもあって参加できず辞めようか悩んでおられます
dialogue.English: You joined a committee in high school, but because you've been unable to attend school or have been late, you haven't been able to participate and are now wondering if you should quit.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校にいけないのは身体がだるくて起きられなかったりするからですが、
dialogue.English: The reason you can't go to school is because of physical fatigue that makes it hard to wake up,

dialogue.content: それは中学校の2年生くらいのときに、いじめられていたころから続いているということでした
dialogue.English: and this has been going on since you were bullied around your second year of middle school.

dialogue.content: このようなお話と思いますが、いかがでしょか
dialogue.English: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私の感じたことをお伝えしてよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: May I share my impressions with you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご自身は高校に入って委員会にも入って、頑張っていこうというとても前向きな、頑張り屋さんだと思いました
dialogue.English: I felt that you are a very forward-thinking and hardworking person, wanting to do your best by joining the committee after starting high school.

dialogue.content: そうですか…
dialogue.English: You think so...?

dialogue.content: はい、私はそうだと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I do.

dialogue.content: 一方で、行きたいけど行けない状況が続いており、身体の調子が悪いのと、少し気持ち的にも落ちてきているのではないかと感じました
dialogue.English: On the other hand, I also felt that you're in a situation where you want to go but can't, and along with your physical condition, your spirits might be a bit low as well.

dialogue.content: そこでご提案なのですが、
dialogue.English: With that in mind, I have a suggestion.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 中学時代のいじめられていたことが、今でも心のどこかにひっかかっているのではないかと感じました。人はモヤモヤを抱えたまま前に進もうとするとどうしても進めなくなることがあるんですね
dialogue.English: I feel that what happened with the bullying in middle school might still be weighing on your heart somewhere. Sometimes, when people try to move forward while carrying unresolved feelings, they find they can't make progress.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そんな時には、自分のモヤモヤした気持ちを誰かに聴いてもらって吐き出すことがとても効果的なんですね
dialogue.English: In times like that, it can be very effective to talk about those cloudy feelings and get them out by having someone listen.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ご自身の学校にはスクールカウンセラーや話を聴いてくれる先生はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: At your school, is there a school counselor or a teacher you feel you could talk to?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 難しそうかな？
dialogue.English: Does that seem difficult?

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 一度、お話を聴いてもらって気持ちがすっとすると思うのですが、それと同時に委員会の方はそれを取り仕切っている先生とかに少し事情を話してみるというのはどうでしょうか
dialogue.English: I think you might feel a sense of relief if you talk to someone. At the same time, how about speaking with the teacher in charge of the committee and explaining your situation a little?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 委員会に出席するだけではなくっても、裏方の仕事とかがきっとあると思うので、そいった仕事を任せてもうらうというのはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: Instead of just attending meetings, I'm sure there are behind-the-scenes tasks. How about asking if you could be in charge of something like that?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: きっと委員会を頑張りたいという強い思いをもっているあなたなら出来ると思います
dialogue.English: I'm sure you can do it, since you have such a strong desire to do your best on the committee.

dialogue.content: 少しでも学校生活を楽しめるようになることを心から応援しております
dialogue.English: I'll be cheering for you from the bottom of my heart, hoping you can enjoy your school life even a little more.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: これで本日の相談終了したいと思いますが、大丈夫でしょうか
dialogue.English: I'd like to conclude our session for today. Is that alright?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい本日はどうも有難うございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした！どうも有難うございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today! I appreciate it.)

dialogue.content: 終了させてください！
dialogue.English: Please end the session!

dialogue.content: （すみません、了解しました）
dialogue.English: (I’m sorry—understood.)
